response_email_lease.name: response_email_lease
response_email_lease.value: ("response_email_delivery"."status"='sending' and "response_email_delivery"."lease_token" is not null and "response_email_delivery"."lease_until" is not null and "response_email_delivery"."first_attempt_at" is not null) or ("response_email_delivery"."status"<>'sending' and "response_email_delivery"."lease_token" is null and "response_email_delivery"."lease_until" is null)

response_email_state.name: response_email_state
response_email_state.value: ("response_email_delivery"."status" in ('pending','sending','accepted','delivered','bounced','complained','failed','suppressed') and "response_email_delivery"."reason" is null) or ("response_email_delivery"."status"='cancelled' and "response_email_delivery"."reason" is not distinct from 'disabled') or ("response_email_delivery"."status"='needs_action' and coalesce("response_email_delivery"."reason",'') in ('recipient-unavailable','configuration','provider-rejected','idempotency-expired','attempts-exhausted'))

webhook_delivery_preview.name: webhook_delivery_preview
webhook_delivery_preview.withCheck:
"webhook_delivery"."workspace_id"::text = current_setting('snapform.workspace_id', true)
    and exists (select 1 from public.membership m
      where m.workspace_id = "webhook_delivery"."workspace_id"
        and m.user_id = current_setting('snapform.user_id', true)
        and m.role in ('owner', 'editor')) and "webhook_delivery"."kind"='test' and "webhook_delivery"."status"='preview' and "webhook_delivery"."attempts"=0 and "webhook_delivery"."created_by"=current_setting('snapform.user_id',true) and exists(select 1 from "form_webhook_settings" s where s.workspace_id="webhook_delivery"."workspace_id" and s.form_id="webhook_delivery"."form_id" and s.configuration_id="webhook_delivery"."configuration_id") and exists(select 1 from "form_publication" p where p.workspace_id="webhook_delivery"."workspace_id" and p.form_id="webhook_delivery"."form_id" and p.version_id="webhook_delivery"."version_id" and p.active)

webhook_delivery_kind.name: webhook_delivery_kind
webhook_delivery_kind.value: ("webhook_delivery"."kind"='test' and "webhook_delivery"."event_id" is null and "webhook_delivery"."session_id" is null and "webhook_delivery"."created_by" is not null and "webhook_delivery"."payload" is not null) or ("webhook_delivery"."kind"='response.submitted' and "webhook_delivery"."event_id" is not null and "webhook_delivery"."session_id" is not null and "webhook_delivery"."created_by" is null)

webhook_delivery_attempts.name: webhook_delivery_attempts
webhook_delivery_attempts.value: "webhook_delivery"."attempts" between 0 and 8 and (("webhook_delivery"."attempts"=0 and "webhook_delivery"."first_attempt_at" is null) or ("webhook_delivery"."attempts">0 and "webhook_delivery"."first_attempt_at" is not null))

webhook_delivery_ack.name: webhook_delivery_ack
webhook_delivery_ack.value: (("webhook_delivery"."status"='acknowledged')=("webhook_delivery"."acknowledged_at" is not null)) and ("webhook_delivery"."status"<>'acknowledged' or ("webhook_delivery"."payload" is not null and "webhook_delivery"."attempts">0))

webhook_delivery_lease.name: webhook_delivery_lease
webhook_delivery_lease.value: ("webhook_delivery"."status"='sending' and "webhook_delivery"."attempts">0 and "webhook_delivery"."lease_token" is not null and "webhook_delivery"."lease_until" is not null) or ("webhook_delivery"."status"<>'sending' and "webhook_delivery"."lease_token" is null and "webhook_delivery"."lease_until" is null)

webhook_delivery_state.name: webhook_delivery_state
webhook_delivery_state.value: ("webhook_delivery"."status" in ('preview','sending','acknowledged') and "webhook_delivery"."reason" is null and ("webhook_delivery"."status"<>'preview' or "webhook_delivery"."kind"='test')) or ("webhook_delivery"."status"='pending' and ("webhook_delivery"."reason" is null or "webhook_delivery"."reason" in ('rate-limited','receiver-unavailable'))) or ("webhook_delivery"."status"='unknown' and "webhook_delivery"."reason" is not distinct from 'receiver-unconfirmed') or ("webhook_delivery"."status"='cancelled' and coalesce("webhook_delivery"."reason",'') in ('disabled','configuration-changed')) or ("webhook_delivery"."status"='needs_action' and coalesce("webhook_delivery"."reason",'') in ('configuration','redirect-blocked','authorization','receiver-rejected','retry-later','attempts-exhausted','payload-invalid'))
